'''Bonekrusha Mask T1''' is a {{gear|5|Kit}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|Equipment with designs inspired by the Bonekrusher Clan. 
The mask is a symbol of fanaticism. Yet faith alone will not keep anyone alive in a Blighted environment. It does not matter if it is dangling from a belt or being worn on the face. This mask is just a piece of flimsy wood.}}
